parts.0.title: Hören — Listening
parts.0.instructions: Listen to each item and choose the right answer. In the real exam each part is played once or twice; here you can listen as often as you like, but try to listen at most twice.
parts.1.title: Lesen — Reading
parts.1.instructions: Read each text and choose the right answer. Richtig = correct, Falsch = wrong. One text can have several questions.
writing.0.taskBn: Your friend Markus has asked you to visit his new house at the weekend. You cannot come. Write: say thank you; the reason why you cannot come; suggest an alternative; ask him another question. Write about 80 words.
writing.1.taskBn: Online forum topic: „Soll Homeoffice für alle Berufe möglich sein?“ Write your opinion: your position, two arguments, an example and a conclusion. Write about 80 words.
writing.2.taskBn: You are writing to the organiser of an exam course: you were ill and could not take the exam. Apologise; ask for a new date; say you are sending a doctor's certificate. About 40 words, in polite language (Sie).
speaking.0.instructions: You and your partner are planning something together. Make suggestions, ask for opinions, react and reach a decision (about 3 minutes).
speaking.0.prompts.0.bn: Leaving party for a colleague — place, time, gift, food
speaking.0.prompts.1.bn: Trip with the course — where, how, how much?
speaking.0.prompts.2.bn: Friend's move — who will help, car, food?
speaking.1.instructions: Speak for 1–2 minutes about a topic: introduction, your own experience, comparison with your country, advantages and disadvantages, conclusion. Then compare with the model.
speaking.2.instructions: After the other person's presentation, ask questions and give your opinion. In your own presentation, answer questions.
speaking.2.prompts.0.bn: Ask a question after a presentation
